title: Simple and sensitive spectrophotometric method for estimating nitrogen-fixing capacity
author: Cordova-Rodriguez, Rentería-Martínez, et al.

steps.title: Prepare NFb liquid medium
steps.instruction: In a 500 mL volume, dissolve the following components in the exact order to avoid precipitation: 5 g L⁻¹ malic acid, 0.5 g L⁻¹ K₂HPO₄, 0.2 g L⁻¹ MgSO₄, 0.1 g L⁻¹ NaCl, 0.02 g L⁻¹ CaCl₂·2H₂O, 2 mL L⁻¹ micronutrient solution (containing 0.04 g L⁻¹ CuSO₄·5H₂O, 0.12 g L⁻¹ ZnSO₄·7H₂O, 1.40 g L⁻¹ H₃BO₃, 1.0 g L⁻¹ Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O, and 1.175 g L⁻¹ MnSO₄·H₂O), 2 mL L⁻¹ bromothymol blue solution (5 g L⁻¹ bromothymol blue in 0.2 N KOH), 4 mL L⁻¹ Fe‑EDTA solution (16.4 g L⁻¹ Fe‑EDTA), 1 mL L⁻¹ vitamin solution (10 mg biotin + 20 mg pyridoxal‑HCl dissolved in 100 mL distilled water), and finally 4.5 g L⁻¹ KOH.

steps.title: Adjust pH and sterilize
steps.instruction: Adjust the medium pH to 6.5 and sterilize by autoclaving at 121 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Set up standard‑curve tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 23 test tubes, each containing 2 mL of the sterile NFb medium. To each tube add one of the following volumes of 0.93 N NH₄OH (standardized with 1.42 N HCl): 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6, 6.5, 7, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 9, 9.5, 10, 11, or 12 µL. Bring the total volume of each tube to exactly 3 mL with additional sterile NFb medium.

substeps.instruction: Add the specified NH₄OH volume to each tube.
Add sterile NFb medium to reach 3 mL total volume.
Measure absorbance at 610 nm and record pH for each tube.
Perform the entire procedure in quadruplicate.

steps.title: Generate standard curve
steps.instruction: Using the absorbance data from the quadruplicate tubes, fit a regression through the origin in Excel 2016 (Statistical Analysis Tools add‑in) to obtain the equation relating absorbance (y) to nitrogen concentration (x).

steps.title: Inoculate bacteria and incubate
steps.instruction: For each bacterial strain (Acinetobacter pitti, A. baumannii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterobacter cloacae, Kosakonia oryzae, etc.), add 100 µL of inoculum containing 10⁵ CFU mL⁻¹ to 4.9 mL of sterile NFb medium, then incubate at 25 °C for 48 h with constant agitation.

steps.title: Harvest cultures and measure absorbance
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the culture tubes at 5000 rpm, collect the supernatant, and measure its absorbance at 610 nm using a Spectronic 20D spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Analyze nitrogen‑fixation data
steps.instruction: Convert each absorbance reading to nitrogen concentration using the standard‑curve equation, then evaluate differences among bacterial species with one‑way ANOVA followed by Tukey’s HSD test.
